title: Goin' For A Stroll
description: Ya 'ave friends, right? besaahds thuh hoss.  Well, ya maahyt wanna let 'em tay-uk care awf yo-wr pahrtner for a bit.  Ifin' thay try raahyt now, thay're prolly not gettin' dreadfully fuh-ar.  That's where thuh command "/horse trust [playername]" comes in.  Usin' this command will let thuh other puh-layer do ta yo-wr hoss anythin' ya kay-yun, save releasin' 'em.  "/horse untrust [playername]" does thuh opposite, takin' away privileges. "/horse trusted" will list all thuh trusted puh-layers ya've gawt
